en.flavor: A standard-issue longsword of the Knights of Favonius. When you're armed with this agile and sharp weapon, channeling the power of the elements has never been so easy!

refinements.1: CRIT Hits have a <r>60%</r> chance to generate a small amount of Elemental Particles, which will regenerate 6 Energy for the character. Can only occur once every <r>12</r>s.
refinements.2: CRIT Hits have a <r>70%</r> chance to generate a small amount of Elemental Particles, which will regenerate 6 Energy for the character. Can only occur once every <r>10.5</r>s.
refinements.3: CRIT Hits have a <r>80%</r> chance to generate a small amount of Elemental Particles, which will regenerate 6 Energy for the character. Can only occur once every <r>9</r>s.
refinements.4: CRIT Hits have a <r>90%</r> chance to generate a small amount of Elemental Particles, which will regenerate 6 Energy for the character. Can only occur once every <r>7.5</r>s.
refinements.5: CRIT Hits have a <r>100%</r> chance to generate a small amount of Elemental Particles, which will regenerate 6 Energy for the character. Can only occur once every <r>6</r>s.

fr.flavor: Une longue épée généralement maniée par les chevaliers de l'Ordre de Favonius. Invoquer les éléments est un jeu d'enfant avec cette arme légère et tranchante !
